comparison.objective: Correct a liquid dose to 10.000 g using pipette and balance feedback; candidate configures a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Closed-loop aspiration/dispensing and liquid mass correction versus driver/wrench countertorque.
comparison.success_condition: Final mass within ±0.050 g and pipette disposed versus locked 90° opening retained through cycles.
comparison.reason: Closed-loop liquid dosing does not overlap the candidate's mechanical adjustment ability.
